title: File:Austria-00235 - Mozart's Second Home (19715784776).jpg
credit: Austria-00235 - Mozart's Second Home
description: In 1773 the Mozarts moved into this residence on the then Hannibalplatz (now Makartplatz 8) as the apartment on the third floor of Getreidegasse 9 (Mozart's birthplace) had become too small as the family grew. This roomy apartment offered sufficient space for gatherings of friends and musicians.
